content: {"praised":["Beautiful cinematography of New Zealand wilderness.","Excellent acting by Holly Hunter and Anna Paquin.","Rich symbolism and deep story.","Powerful piano as central motif.","Award-winning screenplay and direction."],"criticized":["Pretentious and dull melodramatic tone.","Boring plot with little interest.","Unlikable characters and poor dialogue.","Lack of background explanation.","Soft, mumbled accents hard to understand."]}
